scope: Mock-DOM lazy GIF loading, exclusive previews, touch and keyboard access, reduced motion, environmental pause gates, cleanup.

results.name: No GIF is requested before first activation, including after becoming visible
Hover activates only one card and repeated state avoids unnecessary image reloads
Keyboard focus starts motion, survives movement within card and stops when focus leaves
Manual pause remains paused across hover, focus and environmental changes
A first touch tap plays despite intervening focus, and the second tap pauses
Explicit play continues after hover leaves but yields to another selected card
Reduced motion suppresses automatic previews while allowing deliberate play
Hidden, offscreen and Studio gates pause all GIFs until every gate permits playback
Leaving Overview discards stale automatic hover and keyboard focus
Canceled pointer intent cannot alter a later keyboard click
Disposal restores posters, removes listeners and disconnects observers
Missing optional APIs, absent Overview and incomplete cards are handled safely
